variants.full: Released Rasch hybrid and public count prior
variants.no_rasch: Set all Rasch lambdas to zero; retain count prior
variants.no_count_prior: Set feature_prior to None, activating the native binary-subject-mean fallback; retain Rasch
variants.no_count_prior_no_rasch: Disable both count prior and Rasch; keep the same binary-subject mean

controls: Same published acquisition prefixes, evaluation items, frozen weights, and topic corrections. No refitting or tuning. Only checkpoints where kernel mixing weight is zero.
raw_predictions: Record pre-topic-calibration probabilities too, to inspect calibration interactions.
interpretation: Factorial prediction-component ablation; not a source-held-out test and not a simulation of private-platform feedback.
